column4: cleat#2059: dialect-gated per TEST, not subtest -- these are standalone top-level functions, one per non-PostgreSQL dialect, unlike this package's PostgreSQL-only known-positives which have no dialect suffix at all. PostgreSQL runs, MySQL and SQL Server skip in this PostgreSQL-only job -- four. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_DB set: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./migration/catalogdiff/... -count=1 -json reports exactly these four skips, 0 failures.
